purpose: Measure whether x402, L402, agent-payment, proof-graph, and portfolio discovery pages attract qualified visitors and route them to source/proof surfaces.

events.name: ledger_feed_opened
events.decision: Whether agents/builders inspect the machine-readable feed.

events.name: ledger_source_clicked
events.decision: Which source rows create downstream interest.

events.name: proof_link_clicked
events.decision: Whether visitors move from portfolio surfaces into proof graph and proof packets.

events.name: outbound_link_clicked
events.decision: Which external repos, docs, and proof sources attract qualified exits.

utmConventions.utm_source: lowercase source, for example x, linkedin, github, newsletter
utmConventions.utm_medium: channel type, for example social, referral, email, directory
utmConventions.utm_campaign: campaign or artifact, for example agent_payment_ledger
utmConventions.utm_content: placement, for example home_ticket, proof_graph, feed_link
